'''Gravdinian Ale''' was a sweet-flavored beer that was considered one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most deadly alcoholic beverages. It gave off a powerful vapor during the fermentation stage, under the right conditions and in concentrated amounts, this vapor could be lethal. Even with the apparent dangers, it was widely consumed across the galaxy.<ref name="OOAK" />
